original_finding_content.subject: Seller reviews Kichink positively at 7.5% commission, notes social sharing bug (OUT OF WINDOW — undated, likely 2017)
original_finding_content.raw_text:
- **Finding ID:** F-X25
- **What:** Seller Angel Decuir reviews Kichink's seller interface positively, noting 7.5% commission is acceptable, but reports that social media sharing fails to capture product images, showing only the Kichink logo.
- **Verbatim snippet:** "Obviamente es gratis todo, pero el inconveniente obligatorio es que Kichink se lleva un pequeño porcentaje de cada venta que realices (7.5%), por mi parte es aceptable, es como el pago por usar la plataforma"
- **Source:** https://www.angeldecuir.com.mx/probando-la-tienda-online-kichink/
- **source_type:** blog
- **verification_status:** blocked_url_index_verified
- **Date:** Accessed April 2026; page undated
- **Notes:** OUT OF WINDOW. Seller: Angel Decuir (graphic designer, ~20 years experience). Commission: 7.5%. First-impression review before making sales. Positive/neutral tone. Page returned server error on direct fetch; content verified from search engine snippets. Content likely from 2017 based on 7.5% commission rate (pre-increase).
